component-metadata.description:
Node for the imputation of missing values in proteomic data using the standard imputation approach from Perseus computational platform, where missing values are imputed by random draws from normal distribution (http://www.coxdocs.org/doku.php?id=perseus:user:activities:matrixprocessing:imputation:replacemissingfromgaussian).
On the input user is expected to provide: * log2 transformed normalized protein or peptide intensities (in a format of e.g. MaxQuant software output), * parameters of distribution values for imputation will be drawn from: ** d-value, specifying the value by which the distribution is down-shifted (default 1.8) in the units of SD of measured values ** w-value, specifying the width of the distribution relative to the standard deviation of measured values (default 0.3) ** whether the imputation should be done column-wise (default) or whole dataset-wise
